context_for_next_testing_agent: Deploy fix verified via ERESOLVE reproduce+fix in /tmp. All 3 vercel/npmrc configs are correct. Landing page + demo widget + /login + /signup all functional at http://localhost:3000. The preview URL https://sla-guardian.preview.emergentagent.com should behave identically once deployed.
rca of the issue: npm's default strict peer-dep resolver (npm v7+) blocks install when react-day-picker@8.10.1 declares peer date-fns ^2.28||^3.0 while the project pins date-fns@4.1.0 (and similarly does not declare React 19 peer). Yarn (used locally) ignores these conflicts by default, so build works locally but Vercel (npm) errors with ERESOLVE. Mitigation: /app/frontend/.npmrc with 'legacy-peer-deps=true' + explicit '--legacy-peer-deps' in both vercel.json installCommands. Verified by copying package.json alone (fails ERESOLVE) then adding .npmrc (installs cleanly).
